description: Add a custom check, as "Add a custom check" on the Problems page does: a problem category written by hand. From then on the judge looks for it in every conversation, problems found are sorted into it, and it gets a fix written for it like any other category. It is how a user teaches the judge something to watch for. Problems found before stay where they are until sorted; sort_problems moves the unsorted ones in.

description.description: What counts as this problem, in a sentence or two. Optional.
description.title: Description

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

severity.description: major or minor: the tier a problem it finds starts at.
severity.title: Severity

title.description: What the judge should look for, as a short problem title.
title.title: Title

name: create_custom_check
